name: Night Chopper
instructions: omr/instructions/8825-1/ (scans; the helicopter is steps 1-15, pages 2-8, and the cover, page 1; an alternate model on pages 9-12; motorising it with the 8720 motor set on pages 13-16)

functions.does: The handwheel on the right side turns the main rotor: the crown gear on its cross axle drives the 8 tooth gear at the foot of the rotor mast.
functions.source: book: step 8 (cross axle and crown gear), step 11 (rotor mast and 8 tooth gear), steps 13-14 (rotor and handwheel); cover, page 1

functions.does: The same handwheel turns the tail rotor: the crown gear drives a 14 tooth bevel gear on the front of a shaft running back along the tail boom, whose bevel gear at the tail drives the bevel gear on the tail rotor's cross axle.
functions.source: book: steps 8 and 10 (the shaft and its bevel gears); the cover's arrow round the tail rotor, page 1; that the front bevel gear is driven by the crown gear is inferred from where step 10 puts it, just behind the crown gear

functions.does: The round white light on the nose turns freely on its pin.
functions.source: inferred: step 4 fits it on an axle pin; the book doesn't say it should turn

functions.does: The airframe holds its shape: the two skids, their four grey struts and the grey canopy frame of thin liftarms stay fixed to the body whatever is turned.
functions.note: not a control: what every other function needs to hold still
